reviews.title: Fraudulent Charging Practices
reviews.text:
⚠️ Parents: AVOID this app — deceptive subscriptions will drain your wallet.
The game itself may seem fun for kids with its cute veggie characters, but the subscription screen is a trap. It floods you with 20+ confusing “FREE TRIAL!” options, many leading to $9.99/week (over $500/year) or $19.99/month auto-renewals. A cheap $59.99/year plan exists, but the UI buries it among duplicates and prominent “FREE TRIAL!” labels designed to trick rushed parents.
This is a classic dark pattern: choice overload + misleading language to push expensive recurring charges. Many positive reviews were likely written before they switched to this scheme.
Do not tap Subscribe without carefully checking every line and calculating the real annual cost. Cancel immediately if tricked. Apple needs to crack down on this. Save your money and look for transparent apps.
